What's the best birthday you have ever had?
My 21st. I legally enjoyed adult beverages for the first time, hung out with my bro, and watched cartoons. No regrets.
My 1st birthday, not a care in the world.

Easily, it was my 21st birthday.

My sister had a business meeting in Las Vegas and offered me a weekend out there for my birthday. I, of course, said yes. The first night, we went to dinner with her boss at Mandala Bay. He said that he was leaving that night but had the room for the night and offered for us to use it. We agreed. After dinner, we got tickets to see B.B. King perform. Jeff Beck also performed. It was an amazing show.

The following day, we moved our stuff to a Holiday Inn and went back to the strip. Now that it is Saturday (and officially my birthday), I started gambling. Lost a bit, but was expecting to. It was getting to be evening and we headed over to MGM Grand. There, we saw George Carlin perform. 2 drink minimum but the room was packed.

Sunday, we just gambled a little bit more, got our things and went home. Best birthday ever!
That is the most responsible Vegas 21st birthday Ive ever heard of. Maybe the most responsible Vegas birthday at any age. Good on you for playing it right, I would have loved to see George Carlin.
